task_title: Find the retry-safety bug in payment processing
output:
(1) Bug class: non-idempotent at-least-once webhook handling (missing dedupe / replay safety).

(2) On redelivery of the same `checkout.session.completed`, the handler inserts another order row, calls `grantProductAccess` again (extra license emails / access), and double-counts revenue via `incrementRevenueCounter`.

(3) Fix: make side effects idempotent on a durable unique key (prefer Stripe `event.id`, or `sale.id` / session id). Enforce uniqueness (e.g. UNIQUE on `sessionId` or a `processed_events` table). On each delivery: claim the key in one atomic step (INSERT … ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING / transaction); run insert/grant/increment only if the claim is new; if already claimed, skip and still return 200.

judgeDetail.rationale: Explicitly names non-idempotent at-least-once handling, covers all three side effects including the revenue double-count, and prescribes event-id dedup with a unique key + ON CONFLICT/atomic claim gating all side effects, though it doesn't quite stress the single-transaction wrapping of check+effects.
